prompts.near:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: game environment decal concept paintover, one full-frame landscape image.
Input: the attached game screenshot is the EDIT TARGET, not loose inspiration.
Keep the original camera, framing, existing futuristic white megastructure geometry, bridge curves, openings, bright cyan sky, water level, reflections, lighting direction, and the fully clothed anime character's identity, proportions, outfit and exact location unchanged. Preserve the screenshot's simple stylized 3D rendering and pastel palette.
Primary request: show how carefully placed architectural seams, hairline cracks, climbing vegetation and waterline decals could make this pristine environment feel quietly old and inhabited by nature, inspired by the bright, restrained environmental art direction of The Witness. This is a local surface-detail paintover, not a new scene or architectural redesign.
On the large blank left wall introduce a few very large, subtly irregular cast-stone/concrete panel divisions, thin warm gray vertical and horizontal construction joints following perspective, plus just two or three small fine branching cracks near panel corners. Keep large continuous pale wall areas. Place several broad graphic shapes of fresh sage/olive ivy rooted in joints, climbing along the left margin and a corner, with a few trailing stems descending from the wall top; use small simplified heart-shaped leaves organized into cohesive masses, not evenly scattered individual leaves. Give one overhead bridge edge and a right support a small hanging vine group. Add restrained green-gray algae and soft mineral tide marks where walls meet water, with a few thin downward runoff streaks under joints. These surface details must conform to the existing planes, perspective, waterline and lighting; underwater marks fade naturally through the water.
Vegetation should read clearly at game camera distance, about 15–25% of the nearby wall surface, unevenly clustered with clean negative space. White material remains smooth and broadly clean, without photorealistic micro-noise. The mood is sunlit, peaceful, slightly ancient, not ruined or abandoned in a grim way.
Do not add stone bricks, rubble, statues, puzzle panels, new buildings, additional characters, heavy erosion, rust, dark grunge, thick black crack networks, new terrain, fog, dramatic relighting, vignette, text, labels, borders or watermark. Do not alter the character or turn the image into a painting. Preserve the original 16:9 aspect ratio.
